audit.whatIsWrong: The entire content layer describes a kit Aurelion Sol no longer has. spikes[0] names 'Starsurge stuns' and a 'Voice of Light Q'; spikes[1] gives him 'stars'; spikes[2] says 'star orbit damage'; wants.foe[1] has him 'farming with orbiting stars'; wants.you[1] and wants.foe[0] both name Starsurge. None of those abilities exist in the kit file.
audit.why: Riot's current slots are Cosmic Creator (P), Breath of Light (Q), Astral Flight (W), Singularity (E), Falling Star / The Skies Descend (R). Every fabricated name above was replaced with the real ability and the real behaviour.
audit.corrected: spikes[0..3], early, mid, late, wants.you[1], wants.foe[0], wants.foe[1] rewritten against the current kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated anywhere: Null Sphere 'interrupts channels', and BOTH Breath of Light and Astral Flight are flagged as channels.
audit.why: That single fact is why an immobile Aurelion Sol loses lane to Kassadin at 54% — your Q cuts his damage output and his escape mid-cast. The page instead advised 'survive'.
audit.corrected: winCon, tradeGood, breakdown.early, breakdown.carry, phases[1].why and spikes[0].text now carry it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes was the generic Kassadin clock line and did not match this lane's actual shape, where level 3 is his best stage and everything after is yours.
audit.why: Singularity arrives on a 12s cooldown at 750 range; Falling Star is 120s at rank 1; Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1 and is his only escape. Cosmic Creator also makes his Stardust improvements permanent, so a fed Aurelion Sol never decays.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[2].d and the phase whys keyed to those numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page warned that Singularity deals percent-health damage and executes below a threshold — which matters enormously for a Kassadin building Rod of Ages and Seraph's.
audit.why: brief.missingInteractions flags both resistances-invalidated and execute-threshold; Riot's text confirms 'executes enemies who are below a certain p[ercent]'. Stacking health does not protect you from either.
audit.corrected: breakdown.late, tradeBad, dontsFull[2].d and spikes[1].text now say it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Astral Flight 22/20.5/19/17.5/16, Singularity a flat 12 at 90 mana, Falling Star 120/110/100, Breath of Light a flat 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles; breakdown.late claimed Kassadin 'silences every carry'.
audit.why: Riot gives Null Sphere channel interruption, not a silence. The bullets promised 'Farm W refunds' and 'Force anything before two items' and explained neither.
audit.corrected: Both bullets given matching bodies; breakdown.late rewritten without the invented silence.

edits.after: Eat the magic with the shield and serve the late game he can't cancel. Null Sphere interrupts channels — and both Breath of Light and Astral Flight are channels.

edits.before: Aurelion Sol wins by landing Astral Flight, denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
